ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a walk, tap Pause, then hold Stop; on another, Pause, then Resume and walk on. **Expect:** walking, the strip shows Pause alone (no Stop); paused, Resume (a solid orange pill) and Stop (a soft pill), no outlines, the numbers whole on a small phone; held, an orange fill sweeps across Stop and the replay opens; Resume records again (decision 0208).
